name: UCSB Cubing 2024
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSBCubing2024#43232-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by UCSB Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/), and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2lKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--34f8a4d6a6fedd91d0a08d5bfa615926374091f5/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ09KIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6f5e61da9b573700ceb9ab80a1c469b985cce174/Cube%20Club%20Logo2.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1NKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--928aebc1c75f745abb0b80097896dba5180958fd/image.png)
